# MediaGrow

MediaGrow adalah growth partner berbasis di Palembang yang membantu bisnis lewat content management, Meta Ads, TikTok Live, lead handling, influencer collaboration, dan campaign digital.

Paket utama:
- Content Management — Rp 2.000.000/bulan: 6 Reels, 6 Feed Design, Content Planning, Copywriting.
- Meta Ads Management — Rp 2.000.000/bulan: Setup Meta Ads, Management Campaign, Creative Ads, Monitoring & Optimasi, termasuk Budget Ads Rp500.000.
- TikTok Live — Rp 2.000.000/bulan: 2 jam/hari, 6 hari/minggu, sekitar 48 jam/bulan, host profesional, setting & persiapan live. Device dan tempat dari client.

Bundle:
- Growth (Content + Ads): Rp 3.500.000/bulan.
- Live Growth (Content + Live): Rp 3.750.000/bulan.
- Sales Boost (Ads + Live): Rp 3.750.000/bulan.
- All-In Growth (Content + Ads + Live): Rp 4.900.000/bulan.
- Full Management: Rp 6.500.000/bulan.
